author: astaxxoo
content: Hey guys, here's my week 16 update: https://hackmd.io/@astaxxoo/Sy7nMdfizl. This week I got the light client REST APIs work merged and completed. My PRs for fixing a few spec deviations in these beacon APIs and adding the `LightClientUpdate` to the db layer got merged. I also started my work on the p2p topics for the light clients. I am currently testing this part and looking forward to create a PR for the same in the next week.
